archetypes.name: policy-consistency
archetypes.rationale: Docs-only policy changes need consistency across all linked surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether AGENTS.md, the path-triggered rule, and docs/python-migration.md state the same three Bash exceptions. Check that thin wrappers are described as forward-looking glue only and not as migration cutover shims. Verify the new rule paths match the planned shell-script edit surfaces without adding workflow YAML noise. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
